doc.title: Jon Hendricks — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Seventh son, successor to father, no voice lessons
summary: Numerology of his birth, his sense of being chosen, and that he never studied voice and was the only musical child.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Your mom said that you were blessed. What does she mean by that? Also, tied to that, you were picked as your father’s successor. Is that sort of biblical? The seventh son?

Yes, yes. They knew more than I understood that they knew, because I’m the ninth child and the seventh son. 9 and 7 are 16. I’m born the ninth month on the sixteenth day, and 1 and 6 are 7. So that’s mysterious too. I think they knew more than we ever knew that they knew, but it was of a spiritual knowledge, so it wasn’t anything that they ever talked about.
Did you ever receive any voice lessons while you were coming up?

No, no. I never – even to this day I never studied. My wife just said to me this morning, before I came here – she said, “Dianne Reeves, I talked to her at the Hollywood Bowl. She has voice lessons every week, twice a week, and she practices every day.” She says, “You never practice and you never had any.”
No. I just – I’m the only one in my family of 15 surviving children – we had 17. Two died – but I’m the only one that had any musical talent at all.
Yeah, the only. It’s like a finger pointing: that one. Because . . .
